title: The kb MCP server serves a group's own tools, named as extension point mcp_tools, under the group's prefix and refuses one whose name clashes with a shipped tool
goal: kb_mcp.py reads extensions.mcp_tools (a list of module:attr, each a dict with name, description, inputSchema and a call(arguments) function) and the settings' group name, and serves each as <group>_<name> beside the shipped tools, its description starting with the group name; a tools/call runs call and returns its text, and an exception becomes an isError result. A name that equals a shipped tool's after the prefix, a missing group name or a load failure leaves that tool out with one stderr line naming it, and the shipped tools are served as before. plugin.md section 8 and extending.md describe the point.

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); e=d/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(e/"grp_tools.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=1.0,<2\"\nECHO = {\"name\": \"echo\", \"description\": \"echo text\", \"inputSchema\": {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"text\": {\"type\": \"string\"}}}, \"call\": lambda a: a[\"text\"]}\nCLASH = dict(ECHO, name=\"pack\")\n",encoding="utf-8")
g=d/"group.json"; g.write_text(json.dumps({"group":"kb","extensions":{"mcp_tools":["grp_tools:ECHO","grp_tools:CLASH"]},"extension_paths":[str(e)]}),encoding="utf-8")
msgs=[{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"check","version":"0"}}},{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"},{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"},{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"kb_echo","arguments":{"text":"planted"}}}]
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kb_mcp.py"],input="".join(json.dumps(m)+chr(10) for m in msgs),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,env=dict(os.environ,KB_GROUP_SETTINGS=str(g)))
assert r.returncode==0, r.stderr
out={o.get("id"):o for o in map(json.loads,filter(None,r.stdout.splitlines()))}
tools={t["name"]:t for t in out[2]["result"]["tools"]}
assert "kb_echo" in tools and tools["kb_pack"]["description"].startswith("Documentation facts"), list(tools)
assert "pack" in r.stderr and "planted" in json.dumps(out[3]["result"]), (r.stderr,out[3])
